title: Statistical Code & Simulations
text:
This section hosts all interactive computational tools, R diagnostic notebooks, and statistical simulators for STAC67:

Interactive Regression Playground: In-browser live OLS models exploring outlier influence, leverage points, and coefficient sensitivity in real time.
R Statistical Labs: Complete R scripts for diagnostic plotting (residuals vs. fitted, Q-Q plots, scale-location, residuals vs. leverage).
Python Statistical Surrogates: Statsmodels implementations for matrix verification and simulation checks.

title: STAC67H3: Regression Analysis
text:
📅 Course Roadmap & Calendar (Fall 2026)
Lectures: Wednesday 16:00–17:00 & Friday 13:00–15:00 in IA 2021
Tutorials: Tuesday 17:00–18:00 (IA 3120) or Wednesday 15:00–16:00 (IC 208)









Week
Dates
Topics & Readings (Kutner et al.)
Tutorials & Assessments




01
Sep 08–13
Intro to Regression, Correlation, Simple Linear Model (Ch 1.1–1.3, 2.11)
No Tutorials


02
Sep 14–20
Least Squares, Gauss-Markov Theorem, Residuals, Inference (Ch 1.4–1.7, 2.1–2.2)
Assignment #1 Out (Sep 18)


03
Sep 21–27
Estimator Distributions, Prediction Intervals, ANOVA & \(R^2\) (Ch 2.3–2.9)
R Environment Setup


04
Sep 28 – Oct 04
F-tests, Model Assumptions, Matrix Formulation, Hat Matrix (Ch 3.1–3.3, 5.1–5.10)
Assignment #1 Due (Sep 30)


05
Oct 05–11
Matrix Results, Linear Functions of Random Vectors (Ch 5.11–5.13, 6.1–6.4)
Quiz 1 (Oct 6/7) · Project Brief


06
Oct 12–18
Geometry of Least Squares, Quadratic Forms, General F-test (Ch 6.5–6.8)
Midterm Review


07
Oct 19–25
General Linear Hypotheses, Extra SS, Multicollinearity (Ch 7.1–7.6, 8.3)
Assignment #2 Due (Oct 21) · Midterm


RW
Oct 26–30
Reading Week (No Classes or Tutorials)
Study Break


08
Nov 02–08
Categorical Predictors, Interaction Models (Ch 8.3–8.6)
Quiz 2 (Nov 3/4) · Groups Claimed


09
Nov 09–15
Polynomial Models, Centred Predictors, Box-Cox Transformations (Ch 8.1–8.2, 3.9)
Project Checkpoint Due (Nov 13)


10
Nov 16–22
Model Selection Criteria (\(R_{\text{adj}}^2, AIC, BIC\)), Outlier Diagnostics (Ch 9.1–9.6, 10.1–10.3)
Assignment #3 Due (Nov 18)


11
Nov 23–29
Cook’s Distance, DFFITS, Weighted Least Squares (Ch 10.4–10.5, 11.1)
Quiz 3 (Nov 24/25) · Report Due (Nov 27)


12
Nov 30 – Dec 06
Bias-Variance Tradeoff, Ridge Regression & LASSO (Ch 11.2)
Project Presentations (Dec 4)


Final
Dec 10–22
Comprehensive Final Examination
Scheduled by Registrar

title: STAC67 Problem Sets, Quizzes & Projects
text:
This section houses all official problem sets, tutorial quiz guides, case study datasets, and examination review materials for STAC67.

Course Policy Highlights

Late Submissions: Late assignment submissions are strictly not accepted.
Quizzes: 3 in-tutorial quizzes; best 2 of 3 count towards final grade.
Project Grade Boost: The Case Study Project counts only when it increases your course standing relative to the final exam.
